The '''Super TIE/LN starfighter''', commonly called the '''Super TIE''', was a customized [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/ln starfighter]] created at the [[Maw Installation]] to overcome some of the shortcomings of the traditional [[TIE series/Legends|TIE]]/ln [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]].

==Characteristics==
The Super TIE looked very similar to the standard TIE, although its [[Engine/Legends|engine]] nacelle was slightly larger. The Super TIE, however, boasted a more powerful engine and superior targeting capabilities, making it faster and deadlier than the standard [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]].

==History==
The Super TIE was the result of a hobby project among Maw scientists taking apart and putting back together the Installation's complement of TIE fighters. Eventually dozens of Super TIEs were produced and used as interceptors to seize any [[Starship/Legends|starship]] wandering too close to the Installation. While an improvement over the TIE/LN, it was developed independently of mainstream [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] starfighter research, which created the much more effective [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE Interceptor]].
